_what: Neutral white-wall rectangle per camera for the white-balance step of the exposure calibration (src/data/camera_exposure.py, prereg 13.1 draft): the white balance minimises |mean R - mean B| inside it. Normalized to the colour image (0 = left/top), half-open [x0, x1) x [y0, y1).
_provenance: node_b: redefined 2026-10-08 at the reference tripod position (prereg 13.2) from the D435i framing-only frame framing_20261008_234412 (candles unlit; node_b ~/e5_framing/, not e5 data), approved by the author: plain white wall left of the curtain; excludes the curtain, the light switch, the skirting board, the floor, the objects and the source base. No value was derived from that frame. The earlier node_b rectangle (x 0.25-0.50, y 0.08-0.40, from framing_20261008_214855 at the old tripod position, used by the calibration of eef07c7) ran onto the curtain at the reference position. node_a and node_c: to be defined from a framing frame of each camera at the reference position before their calibration.
